# Covenant Day School — After School — Deep Research 2026

> **Provenance:** Compiled by Claude Code on 2026-08-15 as the synthesis dossier
> behind the structured After School cards
> (`src/data/afterSchoolPrograms/covenant-day.ts`). Source URLs are in the files
> beside this one; every dollar figure and clock time is the school's own.

### The coverage map, condensed

| Division | Dismissal | Covered until | How |
|---|---|---|---|
| JK/K | 1:30 p.m. | 6:00 p.m. | 3 stacked Extended Day sessions |
| Lower (1-5) | 3:00 p.m. | 6:00 p.m. | 2 sessions |
| Middle (6-8) | 3:10 p.m. | 6:00 p.m. | 2 sessions |
| High (9-12) | 3:15 p.m. | — | no aftercare; athletics/activities |

Free before-care 7:30 a.m. school-wide; Wednesdays start 8:50 a.m. (late start —
before-care absorbs the difference at no charge).

### The cost architecture — session-based, uniquely here

Covenant Day prices **per 1.5-hour session** rather than per grade band: $248/month
buys one session five days a week; full JK/K coverage (1:30→6:00) is three
sessions, $744/month by the monthly table or **$6,696 "for 10 Months"** by the
school's own annual table. The annual table is deliberately cheaper than
10 × monthly because "August and December … are exactly half of the listed monthly
rate." Drop-in exists at $20/session.

Comparable-arrangement figure (highest-priced band × latest pickup × 5 days):
**$744/month (JK/K, three sessions) · $6,696 published annual**. The single-session
five-day rate is $248/month — the figure a Lower/Middle family adds per session.

### Verdict-level observations

- The 6:00 p.m. ceiling matches four of the six existing schools; free before-care
 from 7:30 is the differentiator (peers charge for morning care).
- Session-stacking makes JK/K full coverage look expensive per month yet the
 $6,696 annual is mid-pack against Country Day ($9,000-est) and Latin ($9,300).
- No aftercare for grades 9-12, and no published enrichment-class catalog
 (LionsWeb login-gated) — the two disclosure gaps.

---

# Covenant Day School — After School — Enrichment Activities

> **Provenance:** Compiled by Claude Code on 2026-08-15 from the school's extended
> day page and related program pages.

### Sources

- https://www.covenantday.org/campus-life/extended-day
- https://www.privateschoolreview.com/covenant-day-school-profile (named enrichment
 classes, third-party)

### The enrichment layer

Beyond the Extended Day sessions, after-school **extracurricular classes register
separately on LionsWeb** (the school's registration portal), in five stated
categories: **music, art, sports, robotics, and outdoor experiences**.

Named class-level offerings documented third-party: **Piano and Guitar Lessons,
Voice Lessons, Painting, After School Children's Choir (grades 3-5)**, plus
robotics (Junior First Lego League / First Lego League feed from the same
after-school layer).

### What is not published

A current class catalog with per-class fees, days, and grade bands is **not
published on the public site** — LionsWeb registration sits behind a login. The
five category names and the third-party class names above are the documented
extent. No published pricing for enrichment classes.

---

# Covenant Day School — After School — Extended Day

> **Provenance:** Compiled by Claude Code on 2026-08-15 from the school's extended
> day page; every figure below is the school's own published rate.

### Sources

- https://www.covenantday.org/campus-life/extended-day
- https://www.covenantday.org/admissions/faqs (dismissals, free before-care)

### Sessions

Extended Day runs in **1.5-hour sessions**, grades JK-8:

| Session | Who |
|---|---|
| 1:30 – 3:00 p.m. | JK/K only (they dismiss at 1:30) |
| 3:00 – 4:30 p.m. | all JK-8 |
| 4:30 – 6:00 p.m. | all JK-8 — latest pickup **6:00 p.m.** |

Free before-care from 7:30 a.m. school-wide.

### Monthly pricing, per 1.5-hour session

| Days/week | Monthly cost |
|---|---|
| Drop-In | $20 |
| One day | $58 |
| Two days | $112 |
| Three days | $162 |
| Four days | $206 |
| Five days | $248 |

"August and December … are exactly half of the listed monthly rate."

### Annual pricing ("for 10 Months")

| Days/week | 1 session | 2 sessions | 3 sessions |
|---|---|---|---|
| One day | $522 | $1,044 | $1,566 |
| Two days | $1,008 | $2,016 | $3,024 |
| Three days | $1,458 | $2,916 | $4,374 |
| Four days | $1,854 | $3,708 | $5,562 |
| Five days | $2,232 | $4,464 | $6,696 |

### The most-expensive-arrangement figure for the app

A JK/K child needing coverage from 1:30 dismissal to 6:00 p.m. five days a week
buys **all three sessions**: 3 × $248 = **$744/month**, or **$6,696 "for 10
Months"** on the annual table (the school's own top-of-table figure). A Lower/
Middle School child (3:00/3:10 dismissal) to 6:00 p.m. five days is 2 sessions =
$496/month / $4,464 annual. The single-session five-day rate is **$248/month**.

Note the annual table is *cheaper* than 10 × monthly (e.g. $2,232 vs. $2,480 for
one session five days) — the annual figures bake in the half-rate August and
December months. Both are the school's own published numbers.

---

# Covenant Day School — After School — Program Overview

> **Provenance:** Compiled by Claude Code on 2026-08-15 from the school's extended
> day page and admissions FAQs.

### Sources

- https://www.covenantday.org/campus-life/extended-day
- https://www.covenantday.org/admissions/faqs (bell schedule, free before-care)

### The coverage picture

- **School day:** JK & K 8:15 a.m.–1:30 p.m. · Lower School 8:15–3:00 · Middle
 School 8:15–3:10 · High School 8:15–3:15. **On Wednesdays all grade levels begin
 at 8:50 a.m.** (late start).
- **Free before-school care from 7:30 a.m.** until the start of school — no charge,
 per the admissions FAQ.
- **Extended Day Program, grades JK-8**, in 1.5-hour sessions after dismissal:
 1:30–3:00 p.m. (JK/K only) → 3:00–4:30 p.m. → 4:30–**6:00 p.m.** Latest pickup
 is 6:00 p.m.
- The program provides "a nurturing, Christ-centered environment after the regular
 school day" with homework assistance and recreational time.
- Separate **enrichment classes** (music, art, sports, robotics, outdoor
 experiences) register via LionsWeb — see the Enrichment file.

### Who it serves

JK through 8th grade. High schoolers (dismissed 3:15) have no formal aftercare —
their after-school programming is athletics (82% participation) and activities.

---
